svg.title: Heating a fixed-N dimer: charge and conditional spin state
svg.desc: Data from thermal.csv. Right panel concerns only the state postselected to one particle at each site.
svg.text: Heating a fixed-N dimer: charge and conditional spin state
Dotted threshold p_singlet=1/2: conditional two-spin state is entangled above, separable at or below.
The projection changes the state; it does not classify the full unconditioned fermionic density matrix.
